name: Exp_XWAMI_NN3_MMRec
summary: This EA is a trend-following expert advisor based on the XWAMI indicator combined with a 3-layer neural network (NN3) for signal confirmation and a money management recommendation module (MMRec). It enters trades when the neural network confirms trend direction signals from XWAMI and applies dynamic position sizing based on its money management recommendations.
summary_zh: 该EA是基于XWAMI指标结合3层神经网络(NN3)进行信号确认的趋势跟踪专家顾问，并配有资金管理建议模块(MMRec)。当神经网络确认XWAMI的趋势方向信号时入场交易，并根据资金管理建议模块动态调整仓位大小。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于XWAMI指标的趋势跟踪，XWAMI是一种自适应移动平均类指标，能够动态调整灵敏度以适应市场变化。入场条件依赖XWAMI指标产生趋势方向信号后，由3层神经网络(NN3)对信号进行二次确认，只有当神经网络输出与XWAMI方向一致时才会开仓。出场条件可能包括反向XWAMI信号、神经网络信号反转或固定止损止盈。仓位管理通过MMRec模块实现，根据账户权益、历史盈亏和市场波动率动态计算最优仓位。资金管理模块会评估当前风险敞口并建议是否应加仓、减仓或保持现有仓位。整体策略结合了技术指标的趋势判断能力和神经网络的自适应学习能力，旨在过滤假信号并提高胜率。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following based on the XWAMI indicator, which is an adaptive moving average-type indicator that dynamically adjusts sensitivity to market conditions. Entry conditions rely on the XWAMI indicator generating a trend direction signal, which is then secondarily confirmed by a 3-layer neural network (NN3); positions are only opened when the neural network output aligns with the XWAMI direction. Exit conditions likely include opposing XWAMI signals, neural network signal reversals, or fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing is implemented through the MMRec module, which dynamically calculates optimal lot sizes based on account equity, historical profit/loss, and market volatility. The money management module evaluates current risk exposure and recommends whether to increase, decrease, or maintain existing positions. The overall strategy combines the trend-judging capability of technical indicators with the adaptive learning ability of neural networks, aiming to filter out false signals and improve win rates.

pros: 神经网络二次确认有效过滤XWAMI指标的假信号，提高入场质量
MMRec资金管理模块根据市场状况动态调整仓位，风险控制更灵活
XWAMI自适应指标能根据市场波动率调整灵敏度，适应不同行情
多层神经网络架构具备非线性拟合能力，可捕捉复杂市场模式
趋势跟踪与机器学习结合的设计理念具有前瞻性
pros_en: Neural network secondary confirmation effectively filters false signals from XWAMI, improving entry quality
MMRec money management module dynamically adjusts position sizing based on market conditions for more flexible risk control
XWAMI adaptive indicator adjusts sensitivity based on market volatility, adapting to different market conditions
Multi-layer neural network architecture provides nonlinear fitting capability to capture complex market patterns
The design philosophy combining trend following with machine learning is forward-looking
cons: 神经网络权重需要充分训练和定期再训练，否则在市场结构变化时性能会显著下降
过拟合风险较高，3层神经网络在有限训练数据下可能学习到噪声而非真实规律
XWAMI指标在震荡市中仍会产生频繁的虚假趋势信号，即使有神经网络过滤也可能频繁止损
模块间参数耦合复杂，调优难度大，不适合缺乏经验的用户
缺乏对滑点和点差的专门处理，在极端市场条件下可能导致实际执行与回测偏差较大
cons_en: Neural network weights require sufficient training and regular retraining; otherwise performance degrades significantly when market structure changes
High overfitting risk — the 3-layer neural network may learn noise rather than genuine patterns with limited training data
XWAMI indicator still generates frequent false trend signals in ranging markets; even with neural network filtering, frequent stop-losses may occur
Complex parameter coupling between modules makes tuning difficult, unsuitable for inexperienced users
Lack of dedicated handling for slippage and spread may cause significant deviation between actual execution and backtesting under extreme market conditions
improvements: 增加市场状态识别模块，在震荡行情中自动降低仓位或暂停交易以减少虚假信号损失
为神经网络增加在线学习机制，使其能够持续适应市场结构变化而无需手动再训练
加入滑点和点差过滤条件，确保在交易成本过高时不会执行交易
improvements_en: Add a market regime identification module to automatically reduce position sizing or pause trading during ranging markets to minimize losses from false signals
Implement online learning for the neural network so it can continuously adapt to market structure changes without manual retraining
Add slippage and spread filter conditions to ensure trades are not executed when transaction costs are excessively high

risk_points: 神经网络在未充分训练或市场结构突变时可能产生错误信号导致连续亏损
缺乏明确的固定止损机制（止损设为0时依赖动态止损），极端行情下可能亏损超出预期
模块间参数复杂耦合，错误配置可能导致过度交易或仓位过大
risk_points_en: Neural network may generate incorrect signals leading to consecutive losses when insufficiently trained or during sudden market structure shifts
Lack of explicit fixed stop-loss mechanism (when set to 0, relying on dynamic stops) — extreme market conditions may cause losses exceeding expectations
Complex parameter coupling between modules — misconfiguration may lead to overtrading or excessive position sizing

summary_en: This EA is a trend-following expert advisor based on the XWAMI indicator combined with a 3-layer neural network (NN3) for signal confirmation and a money management recommendation module (MMRec). It enters trades when the neural network confirms trend direction signals from XWAMI and applies dynamic position sizing based on its money management recommendations.
